name: Fidget Spinner Mania
author: Addicting Games
description: Fidget Spinner Mania is a fun and easy game based on those popular fidget spinners. Fidget spinners were all the rage. Whether you had actual fidgeting problems or liked doing cool tricks with them, fidget spinners were everywhere. From teenagers to business people, fidget spinners caught on as a way to take a break from all the noise. Now you can play with a fidget spinner without carrying it around with you from the comfort of your computer or smartphone. The objective of the game is simple: swipe and spin your fidget spinner as much as you can to gain coins. Use your coins to purchase upgrades that will make your spinner faster and have less friction. You can also use your coins to unlock cool character skins for your fidget spinner. Click on the leaderboards to see how you stack up against other fidget spinner players.
